<template>
  <view class="product-detail">
    <image class="product-cover" src="{{product.cover}}" mode="aspectFill" />
    <view class="product-info">
      <view class="product-name">{{product.name}}</view>
      <view class="product-price">¥{{selectedSku.price || product.price}}</view>
      <view class="sku-list">
        <view
          class="sku-item"
          wx:for="{{product.skus}}"
          wx:key="id"
          wx:class="{{ {active: item.id === selectedSkuId} }}"
          bindtap="selectSku(item.id)"
        >
          {{item.name}}
        </view>
      </view>
      <button class="cart-button" bindtap="addToCart">加入购物车</button>
    </view>
    <product-recommendations
      productId="{{productId}}"
      items="{{recommendations}}"
    />
  </view>
</template>

<script>
import { createPage } from '@mpxjs/core'
import mpx from '@mpxjs/api-proxy'
import { useProductStore } from '../../../stores/product'

createPage({
  data: {
    productId: '',
    selectedSkuId: ''
  },
  computed: {
    product () {
      return useProductStore(this.$pinia).product
    },
    recommendations () {
      return useProductStore(this.$pinia).recommendations
    },
    selectedSku () {
      return (this.product.skus || []).find(item => item.id === this.selectedSkuId) || {}
    }
  },
  onLoad (query) {
    this.productId = query.id
    this.loadProduct(query.id)
  },
  methods: {
    async loadProduct (productId) {
      await useProductStore(this.$pinia).loadProduct(productId)
      this.selectedSkuId = this.product.skus[0] && this.product.skus[0].id
    },
    selectSku (skuId) {
      this.selectedSkuId = skuId
    },
    addToCart () {
      mpx.request({
        url: '/api/cart/items',
        method: 'POST',
        data: {
          productId: this.productId,
          skuId: this.selectedSkuId
        },
        success: () => mpx.showToast({ title: '已加入购物车' })
      })
    }
  }
})
</script>

<style>

}

}

  margin-top: 20rpx;

  background: #ff5a36;

<script type="application/json">
{
  "navigationBarTitleText": "商品详情",
  "usingComponents": {
    "product-recommendations": "../../../components/product-recommendations"
  }
}
</script>
import { defineStore } from '@mpxjs/pinia'
import { fetchProduct, fetchRecommendations } from '../services/product'

export const useProductStore = defineStore('product-platform', {
  state: () => ({
    productId: '',
    product: {},
    recommendations: []
  }),
  actions: {
    async loadProduct (productId) {
      const [product, recommendations] = await Promise.all([
        fetchProduct(productId),
        fetchRecommendations(productId)
      ])
      this.productId = productId
      this.product = product
      this.recommendations = recommendations
    }
  }
})
import mpx from '@mpxjs/api-proxy'

export function fetchProduct (productId) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    mpx.request({
      url: `http://localhost:3000/api/products/${productId}`,
      success: ({ data }) => resolve(data),
      fail: reject
    })
  })
}

export function fetchRecommendations (productId) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    mpx.request({
      url: `http://localhost:3000/api/products/${productId}/recommendations`,
      success: ({ data }) => resolve(data),
      fail: reject
    })
  })
}
<template>
  <view class="recommendations">
    <view class="section-title">相关推荐</view>
    <view
      class="recommendation-card"
      wx:for="{{items}}"
      wx:key="id"
      data-product-id="{{item.id}}"
      bindtap="openProduct(item.id)"
    >
      <image class="recommendation-cover" src="{{item.cover}}" mode="aspectFill" />
      <text class="recommendation-name">{{item.name}}</text>
      <text class="recommendation-price">¥{{item.price}}</text>
    </view>
  </view>
</template>

<script>
import { createComponent } from '@mpxjs/core'
import exposureSdk from '@business/product-exposure-web'

// SDK contract: create({ productId }) returns Promise<Tracker>.
// Tracker exposes track(eventName, payload) and destroy().
createComponent({
  properties: {
    productId: String,
    items: Array
  },
  ready () {
    this.observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach((entry) => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          exposureSdk.track('recommendation_exposure', {
            productId: this.productId,
            recommendationId: entry.target.dataset.productId
          })
        }
      })
    })
    document.querySelectorAll('.recommendation-card').forEach((element) => {
      this.observer.observe(element)
    })
  },
  methods: {
    openProduct (productId) {
      wx.navigateTo({
        url: `/packageProduct/pages/detail/index?id=${productId}`
      })
    }
  }
})
</script>

<style scoped>

}

.recommendation-price {
  color: #e64340;
  font-size: 28rpx;
}
</style>

{
  "component": true
}
</script>
<script>
import { createApp } from '@mpxjs/core'
import { createPinia } from '@mpxjs/pinia'

const pinia = createPinia()

createApp({
  pinia,
  onLaunch () {
    wx.reportAnalytics('mall_launch', {})
  }
})
</script>

<script type="application/json">
{

    "pages/home/index"
  ],

    {
      "root": "packageProduct",

        "pages/detail/index"
      ]

}
</script>
module.exports = {
  publicPath: '/',
  pluginOptions: {
    mpx: {
      plugin: {
        webConfig: {
          useSSR: false,

          }

}

实现已写入声明的输出路径：SSR 开启并使用 `/mall/` history 路由；服务端请求从当前 `req` 推导协议和 host，浏览器/小程序仍走相对 API；商品与推荐由同一可去重、可防旧响应提交的 store 请求并行加载。现在做一次只针对输出文件的完整性和关键约束检查。

- 浏览器/小程序使用相对地址
